text:
### Escalation  
**Incident Escalation Triggers:**  
| Loss Amount | Escalation | Timeline |
|-------------|-----------|----------|
| <£1k | Department Manager | Report to Risk |
| £1k–£10k | Risk Manager | Report to CRO within 1 day |
| £10k–£100k | CRO + CEO | Report within 24 hours |
| >£100k | Board + Regulators | Immediate + regulatory notification |

raw_entities.name: Incident Escalation Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the triggers, timelines, and reporting lines for escalating financial losses based on the amount of the loss.

raw_entities.name: Low Value Loss Reporting Requirement
raw_entities.description: For losses under £1,000, the Department Manager is required to report the incident to Risk.

raw_entities.name: Medium Value Loss Reporting Requirement
raw_entities.description: For losses between £1,000 and £10,000, the Risk Manager must report the incident to the CRO within 1 day.
context: £1k–£10k | Risk Manager | Report to CRO within 1 day

raw_entities.name: High Value Loss Reporting Requirement
raw_entities.description: For losses between £10,000 and £100,000, the CRO and CEO must be notified within 24 hours.

raw_entities.name: Critical Value Loss Reporting Requirement
raw_entities.description: For losses exceeding £100,000, immediate notification to the Board and Regulators is mandatory, including formal regulatory notification.

raw_entities.name: Department Manager
raw_entities.description: Responsible for reporting losses of less than £1,000 to the Risk function.

raw_entities.name: Risk Manager
raw_entities.description: Responsible for reporting losses between £1,000 and £10,000 to the CRO within a one-day timeframe.
context: £1k–£10k | Risk Manager | Report to CRO within 1 day

raw_entities.name: Chief Risk Officer
raw_entities.description: An executive role that receives reports for medium-value losses and is part of the escalation chain for high-value losses (£10k–£100k).

raw_entities.name: Chief Executive Officer
raw_entities.description: An executive role required to be notified of losses between £10,000 and £100,000 within 24 hours.

raw_entities.name: Board
raw_entities.description: The governing body that must be notified immediately in the event of losses exceeding £100,000.

raw_entities.name: Regulators
raw_entities.description: External authorities that must receive immediate notification for losses exceeding £100,000.

raw_entities.description: A structured matrix used to ensure that financial losses are reported to the correct level of management within specified timeframes.
